title: Great tour
text: The tour was great and the views were amazing
author: shashank n

title: Amazing tour
text:
The "Crociera sul Guadalquivir" was absolutely amazing! The boat ride offered breathtaking views of Seville's iconic landmarks, including the beautiful Torre del Oro and the vibrant riverside. It was so peaceful and refreshing, allowing us to enjoy the beauty of the city in a relaxing and unique way.

Even though it was a self-guided tour, the experience was incredibly enjoyable, with plenty of time to take in the sights and capture stunning photos. Perfect for anyone looking to explore Seville from a different angle while relaxing on the water. Highly recommended!
author: O8950WWcarlaf

title: Magical cruise!
text:
I had the most wonderful experience on the "Crociera sul Guadalquivir." The boat ride was incredibly relaxing and offered stunning views of Seville from the river. The calm waters and gentle breeze made for a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of the city.
While there wasn't a guide on board, the scenic beauty of the city, combined with the peaceful atmosphere, made it an unforgettable experience. It was the perfect way to enjoy the city's landmarks from a different perspective. Highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to unwind and enjoy Seville's charm from the water!
